newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli, PLO negotiators meet for Hebron talks.
newsitem.headline: Israeli, PLO negotiators meet for Hebron talks.

text.p: Israeli and Palestinian peace teams went into talks on Hebron on Tuesday ahead of a planned summit between Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and President Yasser Arafat, witnesses said.

Negotiators, gathering at a Jerusalem hotel, were aiming to resolve four disputes still blocking Israel's withdrawal from 80 percent of Hebron in the West Bank and paved the way for the two leaders to seal the deal.
